draft.title: Spending, GST and best buys
card: Discount
A discount lowers the price. Take the percentage off the price, or multiply by the percentage that remains. A 20% discount means paying \(80\%\) of the price.
GST
GST is a tax of 10% added to the price of most goods. Price with GST \(=\) price \(\times 1.1\).
Unit cost
To find the best buy, work out the price for one unit, such as per 100 g. Unit cost \(=\) price \(\div\) amount. The lower unit cost is the better buy.
Credit
Buying on credit or with a loan means paying back more than the price. Total cost \(=\) deposit \(+\) all repayments.
draft.remember: Discount and GST change the price. Unit cost compares sizes. Credit adds extra to the total paid.

a.q: A pair of shoes costs $80 before GST. GST of 10% is added. What is the final price?
a.why: GST is \(0.1 \times 80 = 8\) dollars, so the price is \(80 + 8 = 88\) dollars. $72 is wrong because it takes the GST off instead of adding it.
a.clue: GST is added to the price.

b.q: Cereal costs $4.50 for 500 g, or $8.00 for 800 g. Which is the better buy, and why?
opts: The 800 g box, at $1.00 per 100 g
The 500 g box, at $0.90 per 100 g
The 800 g box, because it costs more
The 500 g box, because it costs less
b.why: The 500 g box costs \(4.50 \div 5 = 0.90\) dollars per 100 g, and the 800 g box costs \(8.00 \div 8 = 1.00\) dollar per 100 g. The 500 g box has the lower unit cost, so it is the better buy.
b.clue: Work out the cost per 100 g for each box.

b.best: The 500 g box, at $0.90 per 100 g

flags: Question b: the checker picked “The 500 g box, at $0.90 per 100 g”, not the writer’s answer “The 800 g box, at $1.00 per 100 g”.

proposal.title: Spending, GST and best buys
card: Discount
A discount lowers the price. Take the percentage off the price, or multiply by the percentage that remains. A 20% discount means paying \(80\%\) of the price.
GST
GST is a tax of 10% added to the price of most goods and services. Price with GST \(=\) price \(\times 1.1\).
Unit cost
To find the best buy, work out the price of one unit, such as 100 g. For $3 for 600 g, that is \(3 \div 6 = 0.50\) dollars per 100 g. The lower unit cost is the better buy.
Credit
Buying on credit or with a loan usually means paying back more than the price, because of interest and fees. Total cost \(=\) deposit \(+\) all repayments.
proposal.remember: Discount and GST change the price. Unit cost compares sizes. Credit usually adds to the total paid.

a.q: A pair of shoes costs $80 before GST. GST of 10% is added. What is the final price?
a.why: GST is \(0.1 \times 80 = 8\) dollars, so the price is \(80 + 8 = 88\) dollars. $72 is wrong because it takes the GST off instead of adding it.
a.clue: GST is added to the price.

b.q: Cereal costs $4.50 for 500 g, or $8.00 for 800 g. Which is the better buy, and why?
opts: The 500 g box, at $0.90 per 100 g
The 800 g box, at $1.00 per 100 g
The 800 g box, because it costs more
The 500 g box, because it costs less
b.why: The 500 g box costs \(4.50 \div 5 = 0.90\) dollars per 100 g, and the 800 g box costs \(8.00 \div 8 = 1.00\) dollar per 100 g. The 500 g box has the lower unit cost, so it is the better buy. Bigger packs are often cheaper per gram, but not here.
b.clue: Work out the cost per 100 g for each box.
